# 01 geo baseline -- no index (plan 01 B.2 / B.3)

MEASURED 2026-11-19T14:20Z, c05 (32 cores), Doris master dbb9b19391 + plan commits (build 7dfe916aad,
BUILD_TYPE=RELEASE), single FE + single BE in `apache/doris:build-env-ldb-toolchain-latest`, ports offset
+20000 (query 29030, http 28030, heartbeat 29050).  Script: `/tmp/b3.py` (copied below).

## Dataset (B.2)
`geo.geo_pts(id BIGINT, lon DOUBLE, lat DOUBLE)`, DUPLICATE KEY(id), HASH(id) 16 buckets, 10,000,000 rows,
deterministic (`murmur_hash3_64(number)`; SQL below): 80% uniform in the Beijing box lon 115.4-117.6 / lat 39.4-41.0,
20% uniform world lon -180..180 / lat -85..85.  Load: 4.6 s.

```sql
CREATE TABLE geo.geo_pts (id BIGINT NOT NULL, lon DOUBLE NOT NULL, lat DOUBLE NOT NULL) DUPLICATE KEY(id)
  DISTRIBUTED BY HASH(id) BUCKETS 16 PROPERTIES("replication_num"="1");
INSERT INTO geo.geo_pts SELECT number,
  CASE WHEN number % 10 < 8 THEN 115.4 + (murmur_hash3_64(number) % 1000000 + 1000000) % 1000000 / 1000000.0 * 2.2
       ELSE -180 + (murmur_hash3_64(number*7+1) % 1000000 + 1000000) % 1000000 / 1000000.0 * 360 END,
  CASE WHEN number % 10 < 8 THEN 39.4 + (murmur_hash3_64(number+12345) % 1000000 + 1000000) % 1000000 / 1000000.0 * 1.6
       ELSE -85 + (murmur_hash3_64(number*7+2) % 1000000 + 1000000) % 1000000 / 1000000.0 * 170 END
FROM numbers("number"="10000000");
```

## Polygons
- city    = `POLYGON((116.20 39.75, 116.55 39.75, 116.60 39.90, 116.55 40.05, 116.20 40.05, 116.15 39.90, 116.20 39.75))`
- thin    = `POLYGON((115.50 39.50, 117.50 40.90, 117.49 40.91, 115.49 39.51, 115.50 39.50))`  (diagonal sliver; bbox = whole region)
- concave = `POLYGON((116.00 39.60, 117.00 39.60, 117.00 40.40, 116.80 40.40, 116.80 39.80, 116.20 39.80, 116.20 40.40, 116.00 40.40, 116.00 39.60))`  (U shape)

## Results (B.3) -- caches off (sql/query/condition cache), 1 cold + median of 3 warm
mode full = `st_contains(st_polygon(W), st_point(lon,lat))`; mode bbox = `lon BETWEEN .. AND lat BETWEEN ..`
(vertex bbox +-1e-6) AND the same st_contains.  rows scanned = Profile `ScanRows` (merged).

| polygon | mode | hits | rows scanned | warm ms (median) | cold ms |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| city | full | 273,872 | 10,000,000 | 191 | 201 |
| city | bbox | 273,789 | 10,000,000 | 62 | 100 |
| thin | full | 76,897 | 10,000,000 | 227 | 232 |
| thin | bbox | 76,897 | 10,000,000 | 172 | 182 |
| concave | full | 1,001,100 | 10,000,000 | 212 | 230 |
| concave | bbox | 1,001,100 | 10,000,000 | 97 | 114 |

## Findings
1. No pruning today: both modes scan all 10,000,000 rows (`RowsInvertedIndexFiltered` = 0,
   `RowsStatsFiltered` = 0).  The bbox only makes the per-row filter cheaper (cheap DOUBLE compare before S2):
   city 3.1x, concave 2.2x, thin 1.3x (a diagonal sliver's bbox covers nearly everything).
2. **The planar bbox prefilter is WRONG for Doris' geodesic `ST_Contains`.**  city: full = 273,872, bbox =
   273,789 -> 83 true hits lost.  All 83 have lat = 40.05008 > the max vertex lat 40.05: the S2 edge
   (116.55 40.05)-(116.20 40.05) is a great-circle arc that bulges poleward.  So G3's "indexed == unindexed"
   rules out any lat/lon-box index; the cover must be geodesic -> S2RegionCoverer on the Doris-parsed
   S2Polygon (plan 02) is required, not optional.  G4's "bbox baseline" is kept as the SPEED baseline only.
3. G4 target on this data: city scans <= 5% (<= 500 k of 10 M; the hits are 2.7%) and beats bbox 62 ms by >= 3x
   (<= 21 ms).  At 100 M points (Z.3) the scan cost grows 10x; the index cost grows with hits only.
4. Profile counter for G4: `ScanRows` (merged, sum) is what to compare; `RowsInvertedIndexFiltered` should
   then show 10 M - scanned.
```python
import pymysql,time,json,urllib.request,base64,re,statistics
c=pymysql.connect(host='127.0.0.1',port=29030,user='root',autocommit=True,read_timeout=3600,database='geo');cur=c.cursor()
cur.execute('set enable_profile=true'); cur.execute('set profile_level=2'); cur.execute('set enable_sql_cache=false'); cur.execute('set enable_query_cache=false'); cur.execute('set enable_condition_cache=false')
polys={
 'city':   'POLYGON((116.20 39.75, 116.55 39.75, 116.60 39.90, 116.55 40.05, 116.20 40.05, 116.15 39.90, 116.20 39.75))',
 'thin':   'POLYGON((115.50 39.50, 117.50 40.90, 117.49 40.91, 115.49 39.51, 115.50 39.50))',
 'concave':'POLYGON((116.00 39.60, 117.00 39.60, 117.00 40.40, 116.80 40.40, 116.80 39.80, 116.20 39.80, 116.20 40.40, 116.00 40.40, 116.00 39.60))'}
def bbox(w):
    xy=[tuple(map(float,p.split())) for p in re.search(r'\(\((.*)\)\)',w).group(1).split(',')]
    return min(x for x,_ in xy),max(x for x,_ in xy),min(y for _,y in xy),max(y for _,y in xy)
def prof(qid):
    req=urllib.request.Request(f'http://127.0.0.1:28030/api/profile/text?query_id={qid}',headers={'Authorization':'Basic '+base64.b64encode(b'root:').decode()})
    t=urllib.request.urlopen(req).read().decode()
    def merged(name):
        m=re.search(rf'-\s+{name}:\s+sum\s+\S+\s+\((\d+)\)',t); return int(m.group(1)) if m else None
    def per(name):
        return sum(int(x) for x in re.findall(rf'^\s+-\s+{name}:\s+[\d.]+[KMB]?\s+\((\d+)\)',t,re.M))
    return per('RowsRead'),merged('ScanRows'),t
out=[]
for name,w in polys.items():
    x0,x1,y0,y1=bbox(w)
    qs={'full':f"select count(*) from geo_pts where st_contains(st_polygon('{w}'), st_point(lon,lat))",
        'bbox':f"select count(*) from geo_pts where lon between {x0-1e-6} and {x1+1e-6} and lat between {y0-1e-6} and {y1+1e-6} and st_contains(st_polygon('{w}'), st_point(lon,lat))"}
    for mode,q in qs.items():
        ts=[];
        for i in range(4):
            t=time.time(); cur.execute(q); n=cur.fetchone()[0]; ts.append((time.time()-t)*1000)
        cur.execute('select last_query_id()'); qid=cur.fetchone()[0]; time.sleep(1)
        rr,sr,txt=prof(qid)
        if name=='city' and mode=='full': open('/tmp/b3_profile_city_full.txt','w').write(txt)
        out.append(dict(poly=name,mode=mode,hits=n,rows_out_of_scan=rr,rows_scanned=sr,ms_median=round(statistics.median(ts[1:])),ms_cold=round(ts[0])))
        print(out[-1],flush=True)
json.dump(out,open('/tmp/b3.json','w'),indent=1)
```
